title: Choose the visual world for the docs page
question: The roll assigned The Patent Specification. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Patent Specification
options.lineage: granted patent documents: bibliographic front page, numbered claims, margin line numbers
options.thesis: Each sub-feature reads like a granted patent: what it does is claimed, numbered and exact; why it's built that way is the description beside it.
options.viewport: Left: claims index (sub-features numbered 01–11) with search and hatched UNDECIDED stamps. Middle: a front page (title, abstract, last changed by) over a calm serif column of numbered claims, each scenario a 'wherein' clause with GIVEN/WHEN/THEN rows. Right: Description (why), References cited (foundation cards), Related application data (history), Undecided.
options.risk: Can read legalistic or cold if the codes and line numbers take over the column; they must stay in the frame.

raised.raise: State is a mark, not a hue: undecided is a hatched ink stamp, deferred is a struck rule, so it survives greyscale and colour-blind reading.
Colour lives only in hairlines and codes; the reading column stays achromatic.

options.label: The Drawing Set
options.lineage: architects' construction drawing sets: sheet index, title block, revision clouds, revision table
options.thesis: The product as a set of construction sheets: each sub-feature a sheet, open decisions as revision clouds, history as the revision table.
options.viewport: A framed sheet: sheet index on the left, behaviors in the middle, general notes (why) on the right, title block with revisions along the bottom.
options.risk: The most familiar 'builder' metaphor; the title block costs vertical space on short screens.

options.label: Exposure Record
options.case: Fuses poorly: a darkroom tool is a costume on a reading page; readers don't identify with it.
options.kept: A single strict tonal ramp as the only greys.

options.label: Cutting Bench Select Rail
options.case: Fuses poorly: a rail replaces the navigation a reader expects; loses on clarity.
options.kept: State as a mark, not a hue (raised into the roll).

options.label: Orizuru Fold Sequence
options.case: Fuses poorly: a fold sequence implies one linear path; sub-features are a tree.

options.label: Iridescent Cloud Edge
options.case: Fuses poorly: no tie to builders or product records.
options.kept: Colour confined to hairlines (raised into the roll).

options.label: Generative Parametric Identity
options.case: Fuses poorly: a page that changes look per seed contradicts a byte-identical rebuild.
options.kept: Every token derived from one source.

options.label: Warm Consumer App
options.case: Fuses poorly: thumb-first cards hide a dense reference tree.
options.kept: The accent only where something can be done.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Three-panel docs like Redoc: grey sidebar, white column, dark right panel, blue accent.
canonCard.viewport: Sidebar tree with search, requirement cards with scenario boxes, a dark 'why' panel.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from any API docs by design.
